purpose: One framed group of a record card: a titled frame with an optional icon that holds its items, is left out when empty in presentation, and registers with the card's mode so an add chooser can list it.
namedChanges: the imports are the peers': `BothKeptLine` and `TheirRows` from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-one-card-rows`, `useOneCard` and `useOneCardGroup` from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-one-card-context`, `useCardMode` from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-card-mode` (in the source: `gilb-stakeholders-ui`, `./oneCard`, `./cardMode`);
comments made generic (cycle, step, tester and ruling tags, dates, person names and app names removed); no code change.

library.title: Card group (framed group of a card)
library.note: Needs the card-mode provider; for a plain card surface take card. With a one-card-context provider above it, it draws a linked person's rows beside the holder's; without one it draws as 0.1.0 did.
